title: Robot Lab
mission: Build a two-link arm simulator that responds to joint-angle controls.
steps: Read the link lengths, starting angles and limits from the fixture.
Add two labeled joint-angle controls and a reset button.
Draw the arm and show endpoint coordinates in meters.
Add numeric target entry and explain whether a target is reachable.
checks: Zero angles place the endpoint at (L1 + L2, 0).
A 90-degree first joint and zero second joint place it at (0, L1 + L2).
Keyboard controls respect joint limits; drawing and displayed coordinates agree.
validation: Distinguish geometric reach from reach under joint limits.
extension: Add inverse kinematics or a recorded movement sequence.
hint: Work out the zero-angle case on paper. Convert degrees to radians; the second link uses the sum of the joint angles.
